name: Morita
source:
A Divine Sword wielder.

Together with Yoshimura, Morita is a part of the village's senior squad. They were already fighting the Ayakashi as early as 1923. 

He is over a century old, but thanks to the Divine Sword's effects, his aging has been significantly slowed down. As such, he still wields immense power and is able to go toe to toe with the kitsune.

[spoiler]A long time ago, he fought alongside Utano, the previous wielder of Len's Divine Sword. He still detests the kitsune who took his comrade's life.[/spoiler]

[Based on [url=https://k-yomiji.sakura.ne.jp/kyouhime/#a_chara]two[/url] separate [url=https://k-yomiji.sakura.ne.jp/kyouhime2/#a_chara]descriptions[/url] provided by the author.]
